subject: [RFC PATCH v3 8/8] mm/gup: batch contiguous same-folio PTEs into one refcount grab

2026-08-11.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the handling of large memory folios (mTHP) by batching contiguous PTEs into a single refcount grab, reducing the number of try_grab_folio() calls and improving performance. The patch introduces a new function follow_pte_batch() that scans for additional PTEs to be included in a batch, and modifies the follow_page_pte_commit() function to use this batching approach. This results in significant performance improvements, with a 12.8x reduction in execution time for large mTHP folios.
